name: Nya
source:
The woman proprietor of a rare bookshop who helps Kurou in his detective work. She has a bewitching aura and an alluring physical presence about her, but the depth of the mysteries swirling around her is a closely guarded secret - there's a certain something about her that no one has been able to discover... [spoiler]Her full name is Nyarlathotep (ナイアーラトテップ), an Evil and Outer God.[/spoiler]

[From the [url=http://www.nitroplususa.com/demonbane/characters.html]Official Site - Nitroplus USA[/url]]

[spoiler]In [url=https://vndb.org/v234/]Kishin Hishou[/url], after the failure of Infinite Spiral, she managed a different scheme that involved with the son of Elder Gods. This time she is acting as the Game Keeper set up Game of Chaos across space and time for [url=https://vndb.org/c12695]Daijuuji Kuzaku[/url], with his opponent is [url=https://vndb.org/c12696]Another Blood[/url]. By using [url=https://vndb.org/c12696]Another Blood[/url] as the pawn and Demonbane Two-Sword as the vessel, Nyarlathotep capable of summoning the Mechanical Nightmare Deus Machina - Clockwork Phantom.[/spoiler]
